caption:
You wake up with hair static and a cheek crease.

Cotton pillowcases have enough texture to catch on hair and skin while you toss and turn. That grip is what pulls hair into frizz and presses fold lines into your face by morning.

This satin pillowcase set swaps that rough cotton surface for something smoother across your queen pillow, so hair and skin move instead of catching overnight.

A less friction-heavy surface to sleep on, on a set of two, for about $7.99.
